title: Harness knob space
description: One file per harness. Declares the harness's structure (components, mirrored by the pseudocode) and every knob, with where it acts. The same schema is used for every harness; harnesses may have different knobs and components but must use these fields and vocabularies. Extend the enums here (and bump schema_version) when a new harness needs a new value.

repo_path.description: Local path of the harness repository the knobs were read from.

profiles.description: Named configuration profiles the harness ships, if any.

pseudocode_root.description: Folder (relative to this file) holding the harness's .pseudo files.

components.description: The structure of the harness as written in the pseudocode: one entry per pseudocode file (module), class and method. Extracted from the .pseudo files by tools/build_knobspace.py.

real_source.description: Real files this component renders, from the // file: header and @src tags.

calls.description: Class.method names this method calls (best-effort parse).

knobs.description: Knob ids read directly inside this component.

executor.description: Who enforces the logic: CODE = deterministic program code; MODEL = a model following prompt text (not guaranteed); MIXED = prompt text whose result code then checks.

role.description: What the component is in the harness.

origin.description: Where the knob's value is set. Real configuration: config_file, builtin_default, cli_flag, env_var. Otherwise prompt_text, code_constant, or not_set (the harness leaves it to an SDK default).

id.description: Stable id; the pseudocode reads it as θ["<id>"].

component.description: Primary place the knob acts (first reference in its target file).

used_in.description: Every component that reads the knob.

kind.description: explicit = operator-settable without editing code or prompts; implicit = buried in prompt prose or code; absent = not set by the harness.

domain.description: Allowed values: a list, or {min, max}, or null when unknown.

domain_basis.description: code = defined by the harness; observed = values seen in shipped configs; suggested = proposed exploration range, not from the source.

default.description: Value that runs. For layered configs an object such as {builtin, profile}.

profiles.description: Profile name -> value, for profiles that differ from the default.

conditions.description: Conditions under which the knob is active (free text or another knob id).

source.description: Real file[:line] the value comes from, relative to the harness root.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the source line (prompt knobs).
